description: Source code for CLI (command line interface) common methods in Redis, including SSL/TLS support, connection handling, URI parsing, and JSON escaping.

methods.name: cliSecureConnection
methods.description: Wraps hiredis SSL connection setup, with optional TLS support.

methods.name: cliWriteConn
methods.description: Writes raw data to a redisContext, handling internal buffers and leftovers.

methods.name: cliSecureInit
methods.description: Initializes OpenSSL libraries if TLS support is enabled.

methods.name: readArgFromStdin
methods.description: Reads input from stdin into an sds string.

methods.name: getSdsArrayFromArgv
methods.description: Creates an array of sds strings from command-line arguments, with optional unquoting.

methods.name: unquoteCString
methods.description: Removes quotes from a string and returns it as an sds.

methods.name: parseRedisUri
methods.description: Parses a Redis URI to extract connection info, supporting TLS schemes.

methods.name: freeCliConnInfo
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for connection info fields.

methods.name: escapeJsonString
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe JSON output following RFC 7159.
